messages:
incident-bot: ALERT — 2100123456 — rule=prod-rate-spike — High error rate and token burn observed. Affected routes: /v1/embeddings, /v1/rerank, /v1/chat/completions. Top caller: api_key=sk-acme-prod-9f...; 5xx % = 12% over 2m; token/sec spike. Pager: oncall=Elaine. Dashboards: https://dash.redwood.internal/r/spike-2100123456 :rotating_light:

Elaine: ack paging — looking. Anyone else seeing same key repeated?

Elaine: quick skim — repeated long embeddings calls (2048 dims) from sk-acme-prod-* pattern. Chat traffic also slightly increased but not dominating.

Ashok: joining now — paging in. Oncall switch in 30s. What's current GPU pressure?

SRE-Liz: GPUs at 78% memory/compute, inference-queue length up, KV cache evictions rising. Most pressure on embeddings backend (model-v2-embed). Rerank is showing bursts causing CPU saturation on the preproc workers.

maria: CS reported 2 customers hitting timeouts; they flagged acme and a small partner. Both on hosted, not Dedicated.

Elaine: mitigation proposal — targeted per-key, per-route limits: throttle embeddings and rerank for sk-acme-prod-*, keep chat SLOs intact. Proposed temporary knobs: embeddings token_per_min -> 10k, rerank qps -> 1, leave chat at conservative qps so product isn't blocked. Prefer target vs global.

Ashok: I can push a rule to the rate-limiter now. Plan: add rule that returns 429 + Retry-After for matching requests. Example payload: 
```
POST /admin/limits
{
  "selector": "api_key:sk-acme-prod-*",
  "limits": [
    {"route": "/v1/embeddings", "token_per_min": 10000},
    {"route": "/v1/rerank", "qps": 1},
    {"route": "/v1/chat/completions", "qps": 20}
  ],
  "reason": "live mitigation - embeddings spike"
}
```
I'll apply only to that key pattern.

support-bot: Action started by Ashok: applying limit rule id=temp-limit-9876 :gear:

Ashok: applied rule id=limit-9876 (selector=api_key:sk-acme-prod-*) — should be live in ~10s. We will emit 429s for excess requests with Retry-After header.

incident-bot: action-log: limit-9876 applied by Ashok at +45s — scope=route-specific, modes=throttle/429.

SRE-Liz: seeing immediate drop in embeddings CPU and token burn. Error rate for embeddings down from 12% -> 3% in last 30s. Chat queues stable, latency back to baseline on core hosts. :white_check_mark:

maria: CS notified Acme about temporary throttling and that we're investigating. They asked about ETA for revert.

Elaine: plan: keep tight limits for 20 minutes to confirm stability, then slowly relax to a safer mid-point (embeddings -> 30k token/min, rerank -> 3 qps) while monitoring. If safe after 40m, fully restore.

kevin: additional mitigation — disable rerank feature flag for acme to remove heavy preproc load. Command: 
```
rbacctl revoke feature:rerank sk-acme-prod-*
```
kevin: done — ff id=ff-321 disabled for matching keys.

Ashok: metrics now show rerank calls drop to near zero and preproc CPU normalized. Embeddings stable. Will schedule canary increase: embeddings -> 30k (10m), then -> 50k if healthy.

support-bot: message sent to acme: "We've applied temporary per-route limits to reduce disruption and are working on phased rollback. We'll update within 20 minutes."

SRE-Liz: recommend also adding an ACL-level short-term quota to prevent other keys from similar bursts: global-token-burst-limit -> 1e6 tokens/min per org. We can evaluate later.

Elaine: agree but prefer targeted first. If we see multi-tenant pressure, escalate to global.

Ashok: doing canary rollback plan now: schedule increase to 30k tokens/min over 10m window, monitoring CPU, 5xx and token burn. If any metric crosses threshold (5xx > 3% or gpu>85%), auto-revert to limit-9876.

SRE-Liz: set alerts: gpu>85% or embeddings 5xx>3% or queue_length>150 -> page oncall.

maria: I've created incident ticket INC-2100123456 and added CS notes about impacted customers and communication log.

Elaine: handoff — I'm going offline in 10m. Ashok, take the incident lead. Ashok?

Ashok: taking lead. Ack. I'll keep watch for 30m and update. :thumbsup:

SRE-Liz: postmortem notes: root cause likely an unbounded embed batch from acme's ingestion job. Add recommendation: per-route token caps on onboarding keys and rate-limiter safeguards for long-running jobs.

maria: CS will follow up with Acme to advise backoff patterns and suggest client-side batching limits.

Elaine: closing thread once Ashok confirms stable for 30m and canary completes. Thanks all. :heart:

Ashok: will update thread with final status. For now, mitigations succeeded — embeddings error rate back to baseline; rerank disabled for offender. Keeping rule limit-9876 active until further notice.

incident-bot: NOTE — action=limit-9876 applied; feature-flag ff-321 disabled; ticket=INC-2100123456.
